transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. The draft we have calls for a standard evacuation alarm, assembly in the east courtyard, and a general family notice. Before I can approve it, school policy requires me to review the plan with the nurse, counselor, facilities manager, and family liaison. So I'd like us to go through the plan together today and address any concerns from each of your areas.
